headlines.title: Definity Financial Raises Travelers Synergy Target to $125 Million, Eyes Top-Three Spot
headlines.summary: Definity Financial (TSE:DFY) is slightly ahead of its long-term growth plan as it integrates its Travelers acquisition and pursues a place among Canada’s top three property and casualty insurers, CEO and President Rowan Saunders said.

headlines.title: Travelers (TRV) Stock Could Be 45% Undervalued As Excess Returns Impress
headlines.summary: Travelers Companies has seen its share price climb sharply in recent years, which naturally raises a question for you as an investor. Is the current valuation really supported by the returns the insurer earns on the capital it deploys into its underwriting and investment operations? Over the past 5 years, Travelers Companies has delivered a 207.5% share price return, which puts the spotlight squarely on whether those gains are backed by the returns generated on its capital base.

headlines.title: Can Travelers Companies (TRV) Justify Its Price As Truist Flags Better Casualty Results?
headlines.summary: Travelers Companies (TRV) came into focus after a Truist Securities research note highlighted improving casualty insurance results, including progress in the previously unprofitable other liability occurrence line, while property performance remained mixed. Recent trading has kept Travelers Companies in the spotlight, with the share price at US$406.86 after a 1-day share price return of 1.49% and a 7-day share price return of 3.

headlines.title: Casualty Improvement Altering The Investment Case For Travelers Stock (TRV)?
headlines.summary: Truist Securities recently reported that Travelers' casualty insurance lines, including the previously unprofitable other liability (occurrence) segment, showed operational improvement in direct underwriting results. The progress in a casualty segment that had been a drag on profitability signals potential shifts in Travelers' risk mix and pricing discipline across liability lines.

headlines.title: Travelers Casualty Lines Improved, Property Mixed, Truist Says
headlines.summary: Travelers' (TRV) casualty insurance lines improved, while property lines were mixed, Truist Securiti

description: The Travelers Companies, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides a range of commercial and personal property, and casualty insurance products and services to businesses, government units, associations, and individuals in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Business Insurance, Bond & Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance. The Business Insurance segment offers workers' compensation, commercial automobile and property, general liability, commercial multi-peril, employers' liability, public and product liability, professional indemnity, marine, aviation, commercial property and automobile, onshore and offshore energy, construction, terrorism, personal accident, and kidnap and ransom insurance products. This segment operates through select accounts, which serve small businesses; middle accounts that serve mid-sized businesses; national accounts, which serve large companies; and national property and others that serve large and mid-sized customers, commercial trucking industry, and agricultural businesses, as well as markets and distributes its products through brokers, wholesale agents, and program managers. The Bond & Specialty Insurance segment provides surety, fidelity, management and professional liability, and other property and casualty coverages and related risk management services through independent agencies and brokers. The Personal Insurance segment offers property and casualty insurance covering personal risks, primarily automobile and homeowners' insurance to individuals. The Travelers Companies, Inc. was founded in 1853 and is based in New York, New York.
